Name: Acceleration
Description: Choose one creature within range. Their movement speed increases by 30 feet. This increase is considered separately from any effects that multiply or divide a creature’s movement speed.
At Higher Levels:
When this spell is cast at 3rd level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● You may choose one additional target.
● The movement speed of your targets increases by an extra 5 feet.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
